title: On release day an open work order keeps its one representative
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Use a work order made for this test before the release was installed: for that customer, open (not invoiced), with sales rep A as its sales representative.
  • Open the design pictures "card-00-b-wo-rest2.png" (board 1.0) and "card-01-b-wo-open.png" (board 1.1) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • With the release installed, open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the work order card.
  2. Invoice the work order.
  3. Open Reports > Sales By Representative.
  4. Set the date range to today.
  5. Turn the Sales Type column on in the column selector.
  6. Expand sales rep A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card shows one "Sales Representative" field reading sales rep A.
  • The card is not split and reads as before.

Step 2:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 3:

  • The Sales By Representative report opens.

Step 4:

  • The report shows today's date range.

Step 5:

  • A Sales Type column shows.

Step 6:

  • The whole invoice is credited to sales rep A as one "Labor, Parts" row.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative), story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • Release day: “Every open work order keeps its one sales representative on both sides and is not split, so its card reads as before.”
  • S5-R10: “When one person, or Unassigned, holds both the Labor and the Parts side of a work order and the Sales Type filter includes both, the two show as one row whose Sales Type reads "Labor, Parts" and whose figures are the sum of both sides.”
  • Feature Overview: “A shop that never adds a field sees one Sales Representative field, as today. The one person is credited with the whole invoice.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
